facts.note: Seção 4 contraindica pimozida "because of risk of QT prolongation". A seção 5.2 manda evitar com outros fármacos que prolongam o QTc e em QT longo congênito, bradicardia, hipocalemia/hipomagnesemia, IAM recente e insuficiência cardíaca descompensada.

cite.locator: seção 5.2 QT-Prolongation and Torsade de Pointes
cite.quote: CELEXA causes dose-dependent QTc prolongation an ECG abnormality that has been associated with Torsade de Pointes (TdP), ventricular tachycardia, and sudden death, all of which have been observed in postmarketing reports for citalopram

facts.note: Seção 4 (Contraindications): "taking, or within 14 days of stopping, MAOIs (including MAOIs such as linezolid or intravenous methylene blue) because of an increased risk of serotonin syndrome"

cite.quote: SSRIs, including CELEXA, can precipitate serotonin syndrome, a potentially life-threatening condition.
Drugs that interfere with serotonin reuptake inhibition, including CELEXA, increase the risk of bleeding events.

cite.locator: seção 5.5 Activation of Mania or Hypomania
cite.quote: In patients with bipolar disorder, treating a depressive episode with CELEXA or another antidepressant may precipitate a mixed/manic episode.

Adverse reactions after discontinuation of serotonergic antidepressants, particularly after abrupt discontinuation, include: nausea, sweating, dysphoric mood, irritability, agitation, dizziness, sensory disturbances (e.g., paresthesia, such as electric shock sensations), tremor, anxiety, confusion, headache, lethargy, emotional lability, insomnia, hypomania, tinnitus, and seizures.
CELEXA should be prescribed with caution in patients with a seizure disorder.

The pupillary dilation that occurs following use of many antidepressant drugs, including CELEXA, may trigger an angle closure attack in a patient with anatomically narrow angles who does not have a patent iridectomy.
Hyponatremia may occur as a result of treatment with SSRIs, including CELEXA.
Use of SSRIs, including CELEXA, may cause symptoms of sexual dysfunction

There are risks of persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN) (see Data) and/or poor neonatal adaptation with exposure to selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), including CELEXA, during pregnancy
There are reports of breastfed infants exposed to citalopram experiencing irritability, restlessness, excessive somnolence, decreased feeding, and weight loss

CELEXA is contraindicated in patients: taking, or within 14 days of stopping, MAOIs (including MAOIs such as linezolid or intravenous methylene blue) because of an increased risk of serotonin syndrome
